title: Will Luh Leakyz Vol. 1 by Yeat have above 15000 Album Equivalent Units during the October 23, 2026 - October 29, 2026 tracking week? Above 15K
rules: If Luh Leakyz Vol. 1 by Yeat has above 15K Album Equivalent Units during the October 23, 2026 - October 29, 2026, tracking week, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
IMPORTANT INFORMATION: This event pertains to the U.S. and will resolve based on the value reported by Luminate’s API as of 10:00 AM ET on the Sunday immediately following the October 23, 2026 - October 29, 2026 tracking week.

Luminate Data, LLC is a neutral provider of market metrics which does not endorse, verify or participate in any way in the outcomes of any prediction market.

blind.reasoning: This is the album's full release week. It drew about 5.7M global Spotify streams on day one and about 9.5M by day two, which looks clearly ahead of Yeat's 7-track COCOON EP, and that EP still got about 14K first-week units. Rough scaling from his past albums points to roughly 18-24K units, mostly from streaming. The risks are a fast drop-off for songs fans already heard as leaks, very few pure sales, and COCOON's miss against its projection.
blind.falsifier: A HitsDailyDouble or Luminate first-week figure at or below 15K, for example if streaming fell off sharply after the first weekend because fans had already heard the leaks.

final.reasoning: The 19.5% price likely reflects a low projection I haven't seen, so I've cut my estimate sharply from 74%. COCOON's 14K from 7 tracks and this album's higher stream count still put 15K within reach, so 33% stays above the midpoint.
